lines.trans: Easy on the left cord, little brother: raise your side about ten centimetres higher!
Hold it right there, both of you! From the kitchen door, that curve looks lovely!
How many paper lanterns can we hang along each span without the cord sagging?
Six round lanterns per cord make twenty-four glowing moons above the tables!
Alternate warm gold and soft red so the whole stone courtyard looks like sunset!
Catch the end of cord three down there by the lower branch of the tree, Rocio!
Caught cleanly! Tell me what kind of knot keeps this cord tight until tomorrow night!
Wrap twice around the iron ring and tie a double knot: Grandfather taught us both!
Look how the leaves are moving at the top of the tree: the breeze is waking up.
Do you feel that cool gust that just came in through the street arch right now?
Better wait to unfold the paper lanterns until we test the afternoon wind?
Too late: Ernesto already opened twelve lanterns on cord one AND he is coming out with his poster!

meanings.note: Marks destination, clock time, and animate direct objects (personal a).

examples.text: Vamos a la estación ahora.
examples.trans: We are going to the station now.

examples.text: El desayuno empieza a las ocho.
examples.trans: Breakfast starts at eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Indicates position or movement downward.

examples.text: La cocina está abajo.
examples.trans: The kitchen is downstairs.

examples.text: Te espero abajo en el patio.
examples.trans: I will wait for you downstairs in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Regular -ir verb with irregular past participle abierto.

examples.text: Abro la ventana por la mañana.
examples.trans: I open the window in the morning.

examples.text: Ayer abrimos la tienda temprano.
examples.trans: Yesterday we opened the shop early.

meanings.note: Plural los abuelos also means 'grandparents'.

examples.text: El abuelo está aquí.
examples.trans: The grandfather is here.

examples.text: Vemos los abuelos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the grandfathers from the door.

acabar.gloss: to finish; to have just (acabar de)

meanings.en: to finish; to have just (acabar de)
meanings.note: Acabar de + infinitive means 'to have just done something'.

examples.text: Acabo de llegar del mercado.
examples.trans: I have just arrived from the market.

examples.text: Ya acabamos el trabajo de hoy.
examples.trans: We already finished today's work.

meanings.note: Ahora mismo means 'right now'.

examples.text: Voy para allá ahora mismo.
examples.trans: I am heading there right now.

examples.text: Ahora tenemos cuatro mesas libres.
examples.trans: Now we have four free tables.

meanings.note: Points to something at medium distance or near the listener.

examples.text: Deja las llaves ahí en la mesa.
examples.trans: Leave the keys there on the table.

examples.text: Ahí viene el autobús.
examples.trans: There comes the bus.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition a + masculine article el; al + infinitive means 'upon doing'.

examples.text: Vamos al mercado por la mañana.
examples.trans: We go to the market in the morning.

examples.text: Al abrir la puerta, sonó el timbre.
examples.trans: Upon opening the door, the bell rang.

meanings.note: Alto y claro means 'loud and clear'.

examples.text: Es una pieza alta.
examples.trans: It is a tall piece.

examples.text: Alto y claro. ¿Estás junto a la fuentecita de piedra?
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: A finger ring or a circular metal fitting.

examples.text: El anillo está aquí.
examples.trans: The ring is here.

examples.text: Vemos los anillos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the rings from the door.

meanings.note: Architectural stone archway or violin bow.

examples.text: El arco está aquí.
examples.trans: The arch is here.

examples.text: Vemos los arcos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the archs from the door.

meanings.note: Formed from the verb atardecer ('to grow late'); al atardecer means 'at dusk'.

examples.text: Los farolillos dorados iluminan el patio de piedra al atardecer.
examples.trans: The golden lanterns light up the stone courtyard at dusk.

examples.text: Desde el balcón vimos un atardecer precioso sobre los tejados.
examples.trans: From the balcony we watched a lovely sunset over the rooftops.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb for catching a thrown object or something blown by the wind.

examples.text: ¡Atrapa la punta de la cuerda antes de que caiga en la fuente!
examples.trans: Catch the end of the cord before it falls into the fountain!

examples.text: Casi atrapo el cartel de papel junto a las macetas de menta.
examples.trans: I almost caught the paper poster beside the mint pots.

bajar.gloss: to go down; to bring down; to lower

meanings.en: to go down; to bring down; to lower
meanings.note: Works both intransitively (go downstairs) and transitively (bring down).

examples.text: Bajo a la cocina a preparar té.
examples.trans: I go down to the kitchen to make tea.

examples.text: Bajamos las maletas por la escalera.
examples.trans: We bring the suitcases down the stairs.

meanings.note: Bajo llave means 'under lock and key'; as an adjective (bajo/baja), means 'low' or 'ground' (planta baja).

examples.text: Nos sentamos bajo el limonero.
examples.trans: We sit under the lemon tree.

examples.text: Guarda la caja bajo llave.
examples.trans: Keep the box under lock and key.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine.

examples.text: El suelo está limpio y brillante.
examples.trans: The floor is clean and shiny.

examples.text: Tiene unos ojos brillantes.
examples.trans: She has bright eyes.

meanings.note: Denotes a gentle, pleasant wind, especially from the sea or through a shaded courtyard.

examples.text: Una brisa fresca de tarde entraba por la ventana abierta.
examples.trans: A cool afternoon breeze was coming through the open window.

examples.text: Bajo el limonero siempre corre una brisa muy agradable.
examples.trans: Under the lemon tree there is always a very pleasant breeze.

meanings.note: Invariable before masculine or feminine singular nouns (cada día, cada mañana).

examples.text: Abro la cafetería cada mañana.
examples.trans: I open the cafe every morning.

examples.text: Cada habitación tiene su llave.
examples.trans: Each room has its own key.

meanings.note: Feminine noun: la calle.

examples.text: La calle está aquí.
examples.trans: The street is here.

examples.text: Vemos las calles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the streets from the door.

meanings.note: Shopfront sign or notice board.

examples.text: El cartel está aquí.
examples.trans: The sign is here.

examples.text: Vemos los carteles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the signs from the door.

meanings.note: Proparoxytone; keeps the written accent on -tí- in the plural centímetros.

examples.text: Faltan tres centímetros para llegar al marco de piedra.
examples.trans: It is three centimetres short of reaching the stone frame.

examples.text: Corta la masa en tiras iguales de dos centímetros.
examples.trans: Cut the dough into even two-centimetre strips.

cerrar.gloss: to close; to lock; to turn off (a valve)

meanings.en: to close; to lock; to turn off (a valve)
meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (e -> ie: cierro).

examples.text: Cierro la tienda a las ocho.
examples.trans: I close the shop at eight.

examples.text: Anoche cerramos todas las contraventanas.
examples.trans: Last night we closed all the shutters.

meanings.note: Dar clase de piano = to teach piano lessons.

examples.text: La clase está aquí.
examples.trans: The lesson is here.

examples.text: Vemos las clases desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lessons from the door.

meanings.note: Both the kitchen room and the stove/cuisine.

examples.text: La cocina está aquí.
examples.trans: The kitchen is here.

examples.text: Vemos las cocinas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the kitchens from the door.

colgar.gloss: to hang; to hang up (the phone)

meanings.en: to hang; to hang up (the phone)
meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: cuelgo) and g -> gu in preterite 1st sg (colgué).

examples.text: Cuelgo el abrigo detrás de la puerta.
examples.trans: I hang my coat behind the door.

examples.text: Colgó los farolillos entre las ramas.
examples.trans: He hung the lanterns among the branches.

combinar.gloss: to combine; to alternate; to match

meanings.en: to combine; to alternate; to match
meanings.note: Regular -ar verb for mixing ingredients or alternating colours harmoniously.

examples.text: Combinad farolillos dorados y rojos a lo largo de cada cuerda.
examples.trans: Alternate gold and red lanterns along each cord.

examples.text: La piel de naranja combina de maravilla con la miel tibia.
examples.trans: Orange peel combines wonderfully with warm honey.

meanings.note: Combines with mí/ti to form conmigo ('with me') and contigo ('with you').

examples.text: Tomo café con leche caliente.
examples.trans: I take coffee with hot milk.

examples.text: Habla con calma, por favor.
examples.trans: Speak calmly, please.

meanings.note: Used for piano or guitar strings as well as rope.

examples.text: El macillo golpea tres cuerdas de acero a la vez.
examples.trans: The hammer strikes three steel strings at once.

examples.text: Esa cuerda central suena clara después de afinarla.
examples.trans: That middle string sounds clear after tuning it.

meanings.note: Used for a graceful curve in a hanging cord or arch as well as a bend in a road.

examples.text: Desde la puerta de la cocina, la curva de los farolillos queda preciosa.
examples.trans: From the kitchen door, the curve of the lanterns looks lovely.

examples.text: El autobús giró despacio al llegar a la curva de la calle.
examples.trans: The bus turned slowly when it reached the bend in the street.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number with its noun.

examples.text: ¿Cuántos bizcochos puedes hornear?
examples.trans: How many sponge cakes can you bake?

examples.text: ¿Cuánto tiempo tenemos antes de las doce?
examples.trans: How much time do we have before twelve?

meanings.note: Describes warm sound, light, or hospitality.

examples.text: Es una pieza cálida.
examples.trans: It is a warm piece.

examples.text: Enchufa la lámpara de latón de Mateo... ¡ay, mira qué luz amarilla tan cálida!
examples.trans: Plug in Mateo's brass lamp... oh, look how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.note: Interrogative adverb with written accent.

examples.text: ¿Cómo se llama usted?
examples.trans: What is your name?

examples.text: ¿Cómo encuentro la ferretería?
examples.trans: How do I find the hardware shop?

dar.gloss: to give; to face onto (dar a); to strike (the hour)

meanings.en: to give; to face onto (dar a); to strike (the hour)
meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg doy and preterite di/dio; dar las doce = strike twelve.

examples.text: La ventana da al patio soleado.
examples.trans: The window looks out onto the sunny courtyard.

examples.text: El reloj acaba de dar las doce.
examples.trans: The clock has just struck twelve.

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: Querer decir means 'to mean'.

examples.text: ¿Qué dice la carta exactamente?
examples.trans: What does the letter say exactly?

examples.text: Dime la verdad sin miedo.
examples.trans: Tell me the truth without fear.

meanings.note: Dejar de + infinitive means 'to stop doing something'.

examples.text: Dejo las llaves en el mostrador.
examples.trans: I leave the keys on the counter.

examples.text: Déjame ayudarte con esa caja.
examples.trans: Let me help you with that box.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition de + masculine article el.

examples.text: El bizcocho acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The cake just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Soy vecino del barrio.
examples.trans: I am a neighbour from the quarter.

demasiado.gloss: too much; too many; too (as adv)

meanings.en: too much; too many; too (as adv)
meanings.note: Agrees as a determiner before a noun (demasiado tiempo); invariable as an adverb before an adjective.

examples.text: Tres años era demasiado tiempo.
examples.trans: Three years was too much time.

examples.text: No camines demasiado rápido.
examples.trans: Do not walk too fast.

meanings.note: Marks a starting point in space or time.

examples.text: No hablamos desde aquel domingo.
examples.trans: We have not spoken since that Sunday.

examples.text: Abrimos al público desde mañana.
examples.trans: We open to the public starting tomorrow.

meanings.note: Everyday single-word opposite of rápido.

examples.text: Camina despacio por las escaleras.
examples.trans: Walk slowly on the stairs.

examples.text: Gira la rueda muy despacio.
examples.trans: Turn the wheel very slowly.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (e -> ie: despierta).

examples.text: Me despierto temprano sin reloj.
examples.trans: I wake up early without an alarm.

examples.text: El olor a café despertó a toda la casa.
examples.trans: The smell of coffee woke the whole house.

meanings.note: Diez sobre diez = ten out of ten.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para empezar.
examples.trans: There are ten minutes left before starting.

examples.text: Su recepción merece un diez.
examples.trans: Your front desk deserves a ten.

meanings.note: El doble de... means 'double the amount of...'.

examples.text: El doble está aquí.
examples.trans: The double is here.

examples.text: Vemos los dobles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the doubles from the door.

meanings.note: Las doce = twelve o'clock.

examples.text: El reloj da las doce al mediodía.
examples.trans: The clock strikes twelve at noon.

examples.text: Aquí tienes doce euros de cambio.
examples.trans: Here is twelve euros in change.

meanings.note: Describes gold colour or golden-brown baked crust.

examples.text: Es una pieza dorada.
examples.trans: It is a golden piece.

examples.text: El del papel dorado del estante de arriba. ¿Por qué?
examples.trans: The one in gold paper from the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Los dos / las dos means 'both'.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas azules en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two blue cups on the table.

examples.text: Compra las dos válvulas por favor.
examples.trans: Buy both valves, please.

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

meanings.note: Means both 'to show something' and 'to teach'.

examples.text: Te enseño el patio de la casa.
examples.trans: I will show you the house courtyard.

examples.text: La profesora enseñó piano durante muchos años.
examples.trans: La profesora taught piano for many years.

entrar.gloss: to come in; to go in; to enter

meanings.en: to come in; to go in; to enter
meanings.note: Pairs with en in Spain (entrar en la posada).

examples.text: Entra mucha luz por el balcón.
examples.trans: Plenty of light comes in through the balcony.

examples.text: Entramos en la tienda para resguardarnos.
examples.trans: We stepped into the shop to shelter.

meanings.note: Forms: ese, esa, esos, esas.

examples.text: Pásame ese cuaderno azul.
examples.trans: Pass me that blue notebook.

examples.text: Esa maleta pertenece a un cliente.
examples.trans: That suitcase belongs to a guest.

esperar.gloss: to wait; to wait for; to hope

meanings.en: to wait; to wait for; to hope
meanings.note: Covers both 'wait (for)' and 'hope'.

examples.text: Espere un momento, por favor.
examples.trans: Wait a moment, please.

examples.text: Esperamos que descanse muy bien.
examples.trans: We hope you rest very well.

meanings.note: Pairs with locations (está en el patio) and temporary states (está caliente).

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is ready now.

examples.text: ¿Dónde están las llaves de latón?
examples.trans: Where are the brass keys?

meanings.note: Forms: este (m sg), esta (f sg), estos (m pl), estas (f pl).

examples.text: Este patio es muy tranquilo.
examples.trans: This courtyard is very quiet.

examples.text: Esta mañana hace mucho sol.
examples.trans: This morning it is very sunny.

meanings.note: Festive hanging lantern strung across Spanish courtyards.

examples.text: El farolillo está aquí.
examples.trans: The paper lantern is here.

examples.text: Vemos los farolillos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the paper lanterns from the door.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine.

examples.text: Es una pieza firme.
examples.trans: It is a firm piece.

examples.text: Ahí suena la campana de la entrada. Un toque firme.
examples.trans: There goes the gate bell. One firm ring.

meanings.note: Pintura fresca = wet paint; agua fresca = cool water.

examples.text: Es una pieza fresca.
examples.trans: It is a cool piece.

examples.text: Bien. Pon estas hierbas frescas por encima antes de servirlos.
examples.trans: Good. Put these fresh herbs on top before serving them.

meanings.note: Impersonal present form hay means 'there is / there are'; haber que + infinitive = must / need to.

examples.text: Hay pan caliente en la cocina.
examples.trans: There is warm bread in the kitchen.

examples.text: Ya hemos preparado las habitaciones.
examples.trans: We have already prepared the rooms.

hacer.gloss: to do; to make; ago (hace + time)

meanings.en: to do; to make; ago (hace + time)
meanings.note: Irregular: hago, hice, hecho; hace tres años = three years ago.

examples.text: La panadera hace pan fresco cada mañana.
examples.trans: The baker bakes fresh bread every morning.

examples.text: Llegó hace diez minutos.
examples.trans: She arrived ten minutes ago.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! = See you later!; ¡Hasta mañana! = See you tomorrow!

examples.text: Sigue recto hasta el puente.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead as far as the bridge.

examples.text: Nos quedamos hasta el viernes.
examples.trans: We are staying until Friday.

meanings.note: Affectionate diminutive of hermano.

examples.text: El hermanito está aquí.
examples.trans: The little brother is here.

examples.text: Vemos los hermanitos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the little brothers from the door.

meanings.note: De hierro = made of iron.

examples.text: El hierro es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The iron is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre el hierro.
examples.trans: We talk about the iron.

meanings.note: Means both a tree leaf and a single sheet of paper.

examples.text: La hoja está aquí.
examples.trans: The leaf is here.

examples.text: Vemos las hojas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the leaves from the door.

meanings.note: A la izquierda = on/to the left.

examples.text: La izquierda está aquí.
examples.trans: The left is here.

examples.text: Vemos las izquierdas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lefts from the door.

meanings.note: Junto a + noun works like a preposition meaning 'beside / next to'.

examples.text: Siéntate junto a la ventana.
examples.trans: Sit next to the window.

examples.text: Trabajamos juntos en la posada.
examples.trans: We work together at the guesthouse.

meanings.note: Justo aquí = right here; justo al lado = right next door.

examples.text: La llave está justo aquí.
examples.trans: The key is right here.

examples.text: La panadería queda justo al lado.
examples.trans: The bakery is right next door.

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: Al lado = on the side / next door.

examples.text: El lado está aquí.
examples.trans: The side is here.

examples.text: Vemos los lados desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the sides from the door.

meanings.note: Used with feminine plural nouns and clock hours (las ocho).

examples.text: Las ventanas dan al jardín.
examples.trans: The windows face the garden.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las ocho.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at eight.

meanings.note: Opposite of sucio (dirty).

examples.text: Es una pieza limpia.
examples.trans: It is a clean piece.

examples.text: Aquí tiene un paño limpio y agua fría, Ernesto.
examples.trans: Here is a clean cloth and cold water, Ernesto.

lo.gloss: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)

meanings.en: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)
meanings.note: Direct object pronoun before verbs (lo veo), and neuter article in lo que ('what') or lo mejor ('the best').

examples.text: Ya lo veo encima del estante.
examples.trans: I see it now on the shelf.

examples.text: Lo mejor del patio es la calma.
examples.trans: The best part of the courtyard is the calm.

meanings.note: Los viernes means 'every Friday / on Fridays'.

examples.text: Los vecinos vienen a desayunar.
examples.trans: The neighbours come for breakfast.

examples.text: Daba clases de piano los viernes.
examples.trans: She taught piano lessons on Fridays.

meanings.note: Used for the moon in the night sky and poetically for round glowing lanterns or large shop windows.

examples.text: Los veinticuatro farolillos redondos brillan como pequeñas lunas sobre el patio.
examples.trans: The twenty-four round lanterns glow like little moons above the courtyard.

examples.text: Esta noche hay luna llena sobre los tejados de Valencia.
examples.trans: Tonight there is a full moon over the rooftops of Valencia.

meanings.note: Conjugates like tener (mantengo, mantienes, mantén, mantuvo).

examples.text: Las tazas gruesas mantienen caliente el té.
examples.trans: Thick cups keep the tea hot.

examples.text: Mantén cerrada la puerta para guardar el calor.
examples.trans: Keep the door closed to hold in the warmth.

meanings.note: La mañana = the morning; mañana (without article) = tomorrow.

examples.text: Por la mañana servimos café caliente.
examples.trans: In the morning we serve hot coffee.

examples.text: ¡Hasta mañana a las ocho!
examples.trans: See you tomorrow at eight!

meanings.note: Irregular comparative/superlative of bueno; plural mejores.

examples.text: Esta ventana tiene la mejor vista.
examples.trans: This window has the best view.

examples.text: Hoy el radiador calienta mejor.
examples.trans: Today the radiator heats better.

meanings.note: Dining, cafe, or courtyard table.

examples.text: La mesa está aquí.
examples.trans: The table is here.

examples.text: Vemos las mesas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the tables from the door.

mirar.gloss: to look; to look at; to watch

meanings.en: to look; to look at; to watch
meanings.note: Needs no preposition for 'at' (mira el reloj = look at the clock).

examples.text: Mira qué sol hace esta mañana.
examples.trans: Look how sunny it is this morning.

examples.text: Miramos el mapa antes de salir.
examples.trans: We look at the map before going out.

meanings.note: Agrees with the noun it describes.
In ahora mismo, meaning right now, mismo strengthens the time word ahora. Now comes from ahora; mismo supplies emphasis without agreeing with a person in this expression.

examples.text: Tenemos el mismo trabajo.
examples.trans: We have the same job.

examples.text: Ahora mismo estoy ocupada.
examples.trans: I am busy right now.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: muevo).

examples.text: Movemos la mesa bajo la sombra.
examples.trans: We move the table into the shade.

examples.text: El viento suave movió las hojas.
examples.trans: The gentle breeze stirred the leaves.

meanings.note: Accented más means 'more / most'; de más = extra.

examples.text: ¿Quiere un poco más de té?
examples.trans: Would you like a little more tea?

examples.text: Es la habitación más tranquila.
examples.trans: It is the quietest room.

meanings.note: ¡Buenas noches! = Good evening / Good night; esta noche = tonight.

examples.text: La noche está aquí.
examples.trans: The night is here.

examples.text: Vemos las noches desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the nights from the door.

nos.gloss: us; to us; each other (¡Nos vemos!)

meanings.en: us; to us; each other (¡Nos vemos!)
meanings.note: First-person plural object/reflexive/reciprocal pronoun.

examples.text: ¡Nos vemos mañana por la mañana!
examples.trans: See you tomorrow morning!

examples.text: Nos alegra mucho la noticia.
examples.trans: The news makes us very glad.

notar.gloss: to notice; to feel; to perceive

meanings.en: to notice; to feel; to perceive
meanings.note: Regular -ar verb for sensing a breeze, flavour, or small change.

examples.text: ¿Notáis esa racha fresca de viento que entra por el arco?
examples.trans: Do you feel that cool gust of wind coming in through the arch?

examples.text: En el tercer trozo se nota enseguida el aroma suave del azahar.
examples.trans: In the third slice you immediately notice the gentle scent of orange blossom.

meanings.note: Used for a knot in a rope or ribbon (hacer un nudo = to tie a knot) and a knot in wood.

examples.text: Haz un nudo doble en el anillo de hierro para sujetar bien la cuerda.
examples.trans: Tie a double knot on the iron ring to hold the cord fast.

examples.text: El viernes por la mañana subiremos al balcón para revisar cada nudo.
examples.trans: On Friday morning we will climb up to the balcony to check every knot.

meanings.note: Plural los papeles.

examples.text: El papel está aquí.
examples.trans: The paper is here.

examples.text: Vemos los papeles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the papers from the door.

meanings.note: Marks destination, recipient (para ti), deadline, and minutes to the hour (cinco para las doce).

examples.text: Este paquete blanco es para mi hermano.
examples.trans: This white parcel is for my brother.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para las doce.
examples.trans: It is ten minutes to twelve.

meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg parezco.

examples.text: Este rincón parece un jardín secreto.
examples.trans: This corner looks like a secret garden.

examples.text: La idea nos pareció excelente.
examples.trans: The idea seemed excellent to us.

meanings.note: Traditional inner courtyard at the heart of a Spanish building.

examples.text: El patio está aquí.
examples.trans: The courtyard is here.

examples.text: Vemos los patios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the courtyards from the door.

meanings.note: De piedra = made of stone.

examples.text: La piedra está aquí.
examples.trans: The stone is here.

examples.text: Vemos las piedras desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the stones from the door.

poder.gloss: can; to be able to; may

meanings.en: can; to be able to; may
meanings.note: Irregular: puedo, pude, podría.

examples.text: ¿Puedo ver la etiqueta otra vez?
examples.trans: May I look at the tag again?

examples.text: Hoy podemos desayunar en el patio.
examples.trans: Today we can have breakfast in the courtyard.

por.gloss: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)

meanings.en: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)
meanings.note: Por la mañana = in the morning; por favor = please; gracias por = thanks for.

examples.text: Paseamos por el casco antiguo.
examples.trans: We stroll through the old quarter.

examples.text: Por la mañana entra mucho sol.
examples.trans: In the morning plenty of sun comes in.

meanings.note: Warm everyday compliment in Spain (qué patio tan precioso).

examples.text: Es una pieza preciosa.
examples.trans: It is a lovely piece.

examples.text: ¿Está segura? ¡Parece preciosa y muy calentita!
examples.trans: Are you sure? It looks lovely and nice and warm!

probar.gloss: to try; to taste; to test

meanings.en: to try; to taste; to test
meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: pruebo).

examples.text: Prueba este pan con aceite de oliva.
examples.trans: Try this bread with olive oil.

examples.text: Ayer probamos la mermelada de manzana.
examples.trans: Yesterday we tasted the apple jam.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta pronto! = See you soon!

examples.text: ¡Hasta pronto y buen viaje!
examples.trans: See you soon and safe travels!

examples.text: Esta mañana me desperté muy pronto.
examples.trans: This morning I woke up very early.

meanings.note: Covers room doors, street doors, and courtyard gates.

examples.text: La puerta está aquí.
examples.trans: The door is here.

examples.text: Vemos las puertas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the doors from the door.

meanings.note: Describes the points of a star or compass rose (una estrella de ocho puntas) or the tip of a pencil or knife.

examples.text: La rosa de los vientos tiene ocho puntas dibujadas a tinta.
examples.trans: The compass rose has eight points drawn in ink.

examples.text: Afiló la punta del lápiz antes de empezar a dibujar.
examples.trans: He sharpened the tip of the pencil before starting to draw.

meanings.note: Core connector and relative pronoun (unaccented, distinct from interrogative qué).

examples.text: Espero que descanses muy bien.
examples.trans: I hope that you rest very well.

examples.text: El pan de esta panadería huele genial.
examples.trans: The bread that The baker bakes smells great.

quedar.gloss: to remain / be left; to suit; to meet up (Spain); to stay (quedarse)

meanings.en: to remain / be left; to suit; to meet up (Spain); to stay (quedarse)
meanings.note: Versatile verb: quedan dos ('two left'), le queda bien ('suits you'), quedar al mediodía ('meet at noon'), quedarse ('stay').

examples.text: Solo quedan dos habitaciones libres.
examples.trans: Only two vacant rooms are left.

examples.text: Esa chaqueta te queda muy bien.
examples.trans: That jacket suits you very well.

qué.gloss: what?; which?; how / what a! (in exclamations)

meanings.en: what?; which?; how / what a! (in exclamations)
meanings.note: Used in questions (¿qué hora es?) and exclamations (¡qué alivio!).

examples.text: ¿Qué hora es ahora mismo?
examples.trans: What time is it right now?

examples.text: ¡Qué mañana tan luminosa!
examples.trans: What a bright morning!

meanings.note: Used for a sudden gust of wind (una racha de viento) and a run of good or bad luck (una buena racha).

examples.text: Acaba de entrar una racha fresca de viento por el arco de la calle.
examples.trans: A cool gust of wind just came in through the street arch.

examples.text: El viernes por la tarde habrá rachas fuertes de viento de primavera.
examples.trans: On Friday afternoon there will be strong gusts of spring wind.

meanings.note: Tree or vine branch.

examples.text: Las ramas del limonero dan sombra a las mesas.
examples.trans: The lemon tree branches shade the tables.

examples.text: Sujeta esa rama verde en la celosía de madera.
examples.trans: Fasten that green branch onto the wooden trellis.

meanings.note: Una mesa redonda = a round table.

examples.text: Es una pieza redonda.
examples.trans: It is a round piece.

examples.text: ¿Dónde cuelgo este espejo redondo? ¿A la izquierda de la ventana o a la derecha?
examples.trans: Where do I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number.

examples.text: Es una pieza roja.
examples.trans: It is a red piece.

examples.text: ¡Dígales que la mía tiene una cinta roja en el bolsillo de arriba!
examples.trans: Tell them mine has a red ribbon in the top pocket!

salir.gloss: to go out; to come out; to leave

meanings.en: to go out; to come out; to leave
meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg salgo; salir corriendo = run out.

examples.text: El pan acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The bread just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Salgo temprano hacia la estación.
examples.trans: I leave early for the station.

se.gloss: himself / herself / yourself / themselves; impersonal one

meanings.en: himself / herself / yourself / themselves; impersonal one
meanings.note: Reflexive, reciprocal, passive/impersonal pronoun, and indirect object le/les before lo/la.

examples.text: La puerta se abre despacio.
examples.trans: The door opens slowly.

examples.text: Aquí se oye el canto de los pájaros.
examples.trans: Here you can hear the birds singing.

meanings.note: Las seis = six o'clock.

examples.text: Me despierto a las seis y media.
examples.trans: I wake up at six thirty.

examples.text: Tengo seis limones en la cesta.
examples.trans: I have six lemons in the basket.

meanings.note: Followed by bare nouns (sin azúcar, sin sal) or infinitives (sin abrir = unopened).

examples.text: Tomo el té sin azúcar, gracias.
examples.trans: I take my tea without sugar, thank you.

examples.text: Salió de casa sin abrigo.
examples.trans: He left home without a coat.

sobre.gloss: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)

meanings.en: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)
meanings.note: Sobre todo = above all / mostly; also a homograph noun el sobre ('envelope').

examples.text: Deja la llave sobre el mostrador.
examples.trans: Leave the key on the counter.

examples.text: Sacó nueve sobre diez en la prueba.
examples.trans: She scored nine out of ten on the test.

su.gloss: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)

meanings.en: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)
meanings.note: Plural sus (su maleta / sus maletas).

examples.text: Aquí tiene su llave, señora.
examples.trans: Here is your key, madam.

examples.text: Sus habitaciones están en la primera planta.
examples.trans: Your rooms are on the first floor.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine.

examples.text: Es una pieza suave.
examples.trans: It is a soft piece.

examples.text: Y mire: esta chaqueta de lana suave está limpia y nueva. Pruébela.
examples.trans: And look: this soft wool cardigan is clean and unworn. Try it on.

subir.gloss: to go up; to climb; to carry upstairs

meanings.en: to go up; to climb; to carry upstairs
meanings.note: Works both intransitively and transitively.

examples.text: Subo las toallas limpias a la primera planta.
examples.trans: I carry the clean towels up to the first floor.

examples.text: Subieron despacio la escalera de madera.
examples.trans: They climbed the wooden stairs slowly.

meanings.note: Por la tarde = in the afternoon; ¡Buenas tardes! = Good afternoon!; llegar tarde = arrive late.

examples.text: ¡Buenas tardes! ¿Tienen una habitación libre?
examples.trans: Good afternoon! Do you have a room free?

examples.text: Perdón por llegar un poco tarde.
examples.trans: Sorry for arriving a little late.

meanings.note: Todo el día = the whole day; todo el mundo = everyone; sobre todo = mostly.

examples.text: Todo está limpio y en su sitio.
examples.trans: Everything is clean and in its place.

examples.text: Camina todo recto por esta calle.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead down this street.

meanings.note: Refers to a span of rope or road between two supports, or a flight of stairs.

examples.text: ¿Cuántos farolillos de papel colgamos en cada tramo de cuerda?
examples.trans: How many paper lanterns do we hang along each span of cord?

examples.text: El último tramo de la escalera de madera sube hasta el balcón.
examples.trans: The last flight of the wooden staircase leads up to the balcony.

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Ponemos tres mesas bajo el árbol.
examples.trans: We set three tables under the tree.

examples.text: Empieza con tres frases cortas.
examples.trans: Start with three short sentences.

meanings.note: Unaccented possessive (tu llave / tus llaves), distinct from accented pronoun tú.

examples.text: ¿Dónde está tu caja de herramientas?
examples.trans: Where is your toolbox?

examples.text: Reconocí tu letra enseguida.
examples.trans: I recognized your handwriting right away.

meanings.note: Forms: un (m sg), una (f sg), unos (m pl 'some/about'), unas (f pl).

examples.text: Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
examples.trans: I would like a hot coffee, please.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el patio.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Shortens to un before masculine singular nouns.

examples.text: Toma uno recién salido del horno.
examples.trans: Take one fresh out of the oven.

examples.text: Contamos del uno al ocho.
examples.trans: We count from one to eight.

meanings.note: Written as a single word in Spanish (21–29 combine into one word).

examples.text: Dos docenas de sillas son veinticuatro sillas.
examples.trans: Two dozen chairs is twenty-four chairs.

examples.text: La recepción está tranquila las veinticuatro horas.
examples.trans: The front desk is peaceful twenty-four hours a day.

meanings.note: hace viento = it is windy.

examples.text: Hoy hace mucho viento.
examples.trans: It's very windy today.

examples.text: El viento cierra la ventana.
examples.trans: The wind shuts the window.

vuelta.gloss: turn; return (de vuelta = back; media vuelta = turn around)

meanings.en: turn; return (de vuelta = back; media vuelta = turn around)
meanings.note: Dar una vuelta = take a stroll / make one turn.

examples.text: La vuelta está aquí.
examples.trans: The turn is here.

examples.text: Vemos las vueltas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the turns from the door.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.

meanings.note: ¡Ya está! = All done!; ya no = no longer.

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is already ready.

examples.text: ¡Ya voy con las llaves!
examples.trans: Coming right now with the keys!

meanings.note: Plural los árboles.

examples.text: El árbol está aquí.
examples.trans: The tree is here.

examples.text: Vemos los árboles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the trees from the door.
